failures.description: smoke/agent-payment-abandonment ended natively SKIPPED: the standing AgentCard sandbox release stall (closed card, balance 0, org transfer consumed, releasedCents=0); the other 14 smoke tasks, including the three other AgentCard lifecycle tasks, passed
failures.evidence: RCA aa757abed1831025a (NOT_INTRODUCED): the native row matches AGENTCARD_RELEASE_STALL_REASON and agentcard_release_stall_task; replaying agents/benchmarks/run_benchmark.py _agentcard_release_stalled on the native lifecycle returns True (purchase HELD, walletFunding RECLAIMING, card CLOSED balance 0, orgTransfer owt_b4dfa680d08414baf5d64fae consumed, releasedCents 0, livemode false). This PR changes no release-path code; its only backend runtime change is the sandbox float floor (100 to 1000 dollars, a read-only wallet precondition). The same stall occurred on 2026-11-06 under the old floor and in the standing case docs/rca/cases/2026-10-02-agentcard-abandonment-closed-card-transfer-never-released.md. Unreleased: 43.96 dollars sandbox plus a captured Stripe test charge (test mode); the other 14 smoke tasks passed.
